title: cheilanthes aurea var. palmeri
intro: Cheilanthes aurea var. palmeri, commonly known as Palmer's lip fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Palmer's lip fern include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Palmer's lip fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which have been shown to contribute to its medicinal properties.
